# Rose Villa

> > Rose Villa is a retirement community in Portland, OR providing residential living and member services.

Rose Villa offers a comprehensive member portal for residents to access community resources, services, and information. The community is located in the Portland, Oregon area and serves retirees with various living and support options.

## Key Topics

- Rose Villa retirement community
- Portland, OR location
- Resident member portal
- Retirement living services
- Community authentication and login
- Senior living resources
- Member services and support

## Member Portal

- [Welcome - Rose Villa](https://members.rosevilla.org/): Member portal login for Rose Villa retirement community residents
